people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.
translations.bsb: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and Barzillai returned home.
translations.kjv: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
translations.asv: And all the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over: and the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
